Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran`. Changeset in the root `.changeset/` when a published package changes. ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Triage first grade 6450997752, verbatim: "**p2, the remainder of #26705** (PR #26839): two more departures still drop a held pillar edit without asking: creating a new object, flow or Interfaces item, and opening another item from Pending changes. Route both through the same departure guard." No maintainer ruling.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure; disproof welcome)

- On `origin/main` `942ffb21`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` has the shared guard `confirmDropUnsavedWork(unsaved, locale)` (≈L450, from #26839). It is used by the surface's leave path (≈L1352) and the three rail switches (Interfaces ≈L5233 `leafHeld`, Data ≈L6341 `objHeld`, Automations ≈L7992 `flowHeld`).
- Create: each pillar opens a `CreateItemDialog` (≈L5021, ≈L6873, ≈L8264) whose `onCreated` sets the new item current. The likely fix asks the guard before the dialog opens, so a decline costs nothing, and does not re-ask after creation. Measure whether creation replaces the buffer the held edit lives in. Only a path that drops the held edit asks.
- Pending changes: `requestSurface` (≈L1878, the `SurfaceDeepLinkProvider` handler) opens an item of a pillar. Measure the same-pillar case (another item while this pillar holds an edit), which must ask. A cross-pillar request already passes the surface's leave guard; measure that and do not ask twice.

### Scope

File surface: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (+ `CreateItemDialog.tsx` only if the open hook must live there) + tests in the shape of #26839's `heldDataLeave` / `heldFlowLeave` / `heldWidgetLeave-26705` files: per pillar, create-while-held asks (declined ⇒ the held edit stays and no dialog opens, or no item is created; accepted ⇒ it proceeds), and a same-pillar Pending changes request while held asks; plus the negatives (no hold ⇒ no prompt; re-requesting the open item ⇒ no prompt). Ablation: drop the new guard calls ⇒ the new tests go red. ⛔ No change to how a held edit is saved, to Publish gating, or to the guard's wording (`engine.edit.unsavedLeaveConfirm`, reused, so no new i18n key).

### Tier

No path-derived mandate. `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `high` (M). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` expected. No changeset (`@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`).
